projectTitle: From Zero Leads to 2,000+ Commercial Interior Projects
shortDescription: Transformed an experienced interior design and execution company from zero digital leads into 2,000+ commercial interior opportunities through a complete brand identity, website, and digital marketing overhaul.
projectOverview: Orange Interior is an interior design and execution company with over 7 years of experience, specializing in commercial and residential interior solutions. When they approached us, the business had strong expertise in interior execution but lacked a consistent brand identity and digital presence to attract and convert new customers. We partnered with Orange Interior as an end-to-end digital growth partner, building their brand from the ground up — from logo design and visual branding to website development and digital advertising. Our goal was to transform their offline expertise into a strong, recognizable brand capable of generating a consistent flow of qualified opportunities.
challenge: Despite having years of experience in the interior industry, Orange Interior faced several challenges: little to no consistent lead generation through digital channels; a visual identity that did not clearly communicate their professional expertise and quality of work; no strong website to showcase their projects and build trust with potential clients; and no integrated digital marketing strategy to consistently reach and convert commercial property owners and businesses.
objectives: Build a strong brand identity — create a professional and memorable brand identity that reflects Orange Interior's expertise and positioning
Establish a powerful digital presence — develop a modern website that showcases their projects, services, expertise, and builds credibility with potential clients
Generate qualified leads — create and optimize digital advertising campaigns to attract businesses and commercial property owners actively looking for interior solutions
Build a scalable growth system — connect branding, website, and advertising into one end-to-end digital ecosystem capable of supporting long-term business growth

process.title: Discover
process.description: We began by understanding Orange Interior's business model, target audience, services, competitors, and growth opportunities.

process.title: Brand
process.description: We developed a cohesive visual identity, including logo design and brand elements, to establish a professional and recognizable presence.

process.title: Build
process.description: We designed and developed a conversion-focused website that presents their services, projects, expertise, and brand story in a clear and engaging way.

process.title: Promote
process.description: We launched targeted digital advertising campaigns designed to reach relevant audiences and generate qualified commercial interior enquiries.

process.title: Optimize
process.description: We continuously analyzed campaign performance and user responses to improve lead quality, reach, and overall digital performance.

solution: We delivered a complete end-to-end digital transformation for Orange Interior. Instead of treating branding, website development, and advertising as separate services, we built them as one connected growth system: Brand Identity → Website → Digital Marketing → Lead Generation. We created a professional brand identity that established trust, developed a website that communicated their expertise and showcased their work, and implemented digital advertising strategies to bring their services in front of the right audience. This transformed Orange Interior's digital presence from a basic business presence into a lead-generating brand designed for continuous growth.

projectTitle: From Zero Leads to 7+ Daily Leads
shortDescription: Built a Meta Ads and Google Ads performance marketing system that took a design education institute from almost no digital leads to 7+ qualified enquiries every day.
projectOverview: Dream Zone Tambaram is a professional design education and training institute focused on helping aspiring designers build careers through industry-oriented courses. When Dream Zone Tambaram approached us, the branch had a major challenge: despite having a strong educational offering, they were struggling to generate a consistent flow of leads through digital channels. We partnered with Dream Zone Tambaram to build a performance-driven lead generation strategy using Meta Ads and Google Ads, with a clear focus on reaching the right audience, generating enquiries, and converting digital traffic into potential students.
challenge: Dream Zone Tambaram was facing several challenges: the branch was starting with almost zero consistent digital leads; their existing digital reach was not translating into enough course enquiries; they needed to reach the right audience interested in design and career-focused courses; and they needed a scalable advertising strategy that could generate leads consistently rather than relying on occasional enquiries.
objectives: Generate Consistent Leads — build a reliable digital lead-generation system capable of producing enquiries every day
Reach the Right Audience — target students, aspiring designers, and individuals interested in building careers in the design industry
Improve Advertising Performance — use Meta and Google Ads to identify high-performing audiences, creatives, keywords, and campaigns
Increase Daily Enquiries — move from inconsistent/zero lead generation toward a predictable flow of qualified daily leads

process.title: Audience Research
process.description: Analyze the target audience, their interests, career goals, search behaviour, and intent to identify high-potential customer segments.

process.title: Campaign Strategy
process.description: Develop separate strategies for Meta Ads and Google Ads, using audience targeting and search intent to reach potential students at different stages of their decision-making journey.

process.title: Creative & Ad Development
process.description: Develop advertising creatives and messaging designed to communicate the value of Dream Zone's courses and encourage potential students to enquire.

process.title: Lead Generation
process.description: Launch conversion-focused campaigns designed to generate course enquiries and connect interested prospects with the Dream Zone Tambaram team.

process.title: Optimize & Scale
process.description: Continuously monitor campaign performance, identify winning audiences and campaigns, reduce ineffective spending, and scale the strategies that generate better results.

solution: We implemented a performance marketing ecosystem combining Meta Ads and Google Ads. Meta Ads helped us reach potential students based on their interests, behaviours, and demographics, while Google Ads allowed us to capture users actively searching for design courses and related career opportunities. The campaigns were continuously optimized based on performance data, allowing us to identify which audiences, creatives, keywords, and campaigns were producing the strongest lead flow. The result was a shift from little to no consistent lead generation to a structured advertising system generating 7+ leads every day.

projectTitle: From a Stalled Business to a Relaunched Fashion Brand

projectOverview: Tunic Fashion is a fashion business that had already established its presence in the market but struggled to achieve the growth it expected. With limited brand positioning and digital infrastructure, the business eventually paused its operations. When Tunic Fashion approached us, the goal was not simply to create a new logo or website. Rebuild the Brand Identity — create a professional and memorable brand identity that gives Tunic Fashion a stronger position in the fashion market
Establish a Strong Digital Presence — build a professional website and digital content ecosystem to showcase the brand and connect with potential customers
Create a Foundation for Long-Term Growth — set up the necessary branding, content, website, and trademark foundation required to restart and scale the business

The new logo established a stronger visual identity, while professional video content and scripted brand communication helped bring the brand to life. The website created a central digital touchpoint for customers, while trademark support provided an additional layer of brand protection. Together, these services gave Tunic Fashion the foundation needed to restart the business with greater clarity, stronger positioning, and a more professional market presence.
